text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on September 28, 2022. Mayor Tory recognized Councillor Rose Milczyn. Mayor Tory acknowledged this was both Councillor Milczyn's first meeting and her last meeting. Mayor Tory thanked Councillor Milczyn for her service and noted that Members were grateful that Councillor Milczyn put her name forward for such a brief period of time. Mayor Tory recognized Councillor Mike Layton who is not seeking re-election and thanked him for his years of service to the public. Mayor Tory acknowledged Councillor Layton for his leadership on Initiatives on the environment and climate change.
